method: Not hand-checked. Each start is the end of a pause >= 0.45 s (10 ms RMS envelope, -44 dBFS) that also keeps the narration between the neighbouring trusted starts at a steady 2.7-3.7 words per second. Only boundaries passing both checks are listed; the other sentences in the clip are omitted on purpose (this narrator pauses as long at commas as at full stops). The LibriVox preamble ends at 14.9 s.
